input: Drop off dry cleaning before Thursday

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing exactly which items need to go in determines preparation steps — gathering, checking pockets, bagging, etc.
Which dry cleaner they are using and where it is affects routing and how much travel time to budget.
The cleaner's opening hours constrain which days and times the drop-off is actually possible before Thursday.
Knowing the immediate next physical step — e.g. locating the items, confirming the address — determines what to do first.
Whether someone else could do the drop-off changes the plan entirely — delegation vs. personal errand.
Understanding why Thursday is the deadline (e.g. items needed for an event) clarifies how much buffer is acceptable and how urgent this really is.
Whether the user wants a reminder, a checklist, or a route plan shapes the format of the plan that would actually help them.

gold.taskTitle: Drop off dry cleaning before Thursday
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to drop off items at a dry cleaner in time for a Thursday deadline.

questions.title: Which specific clothing items need to be dropped off?

questions.title: Why do you need the cleaning done by Thursday specifically?
